name: Sofia Solutions - Emergency Alert System V16 (Grand Identity)

parameters.subject: ={{ '[SOC] ' + ({high:'ALTA', critical:'CRÍTICA', urgent:'URGENTE'}[($json.body?.severity || $json.severity || 'urgent').toLowerCase()] || 'ALTA') + ': ' + ($json.body?.title || $json.title || 'Alerta de Seguridad').replace(/\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})/g, (m,g)=>String.fromCharCode(parseInt(g,16))) }}
